availability_rule: For each ALFRED vintage date, first eligible SOXX signal is 09:46 America/New_York on the next strictly later Qlib-supported session; no same-day assumption. Historical first receipt remains unverified.
same_vintage_numeric_rules: Latest observation of each vintage must be a positive finite monthly value.
MoM uses latest and prior month values in the same vintage column; YoY uses latest and 12 months prior in the same column.
For the January 2026 vintage following the canceled October 2025 release, October and November 2025 first appear together; neither is made available in November or December 2025.
No carry-forward, missing-period compaction, latest-FRED overwrite or market-guided choice.
acceptance: 93 vintage dates and 105 monthly observation rows
each vintage has positive latest value and next Qlib session
any eventual month-growth candidate computed within the same vintage only
limits: BLS PPI indexes can be revised for four months.
ALFRED vintage date is not exact intraday first-receipt proof.
US quality-adjusted industry prices are not global chip sales or SOXX earnings.
BLS 2024 hedonic method change must be considered before a fixed information screen.
